visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a white baseball cap, a black face mask, and a dark apron is actively stir-frying food in a large metal wok. They are standing in an outdoor street-side stall area with a blue and white striped tarp behind them and a parked white car in the background. (2) Close-up shot showing a large metal spoon scooping a mixture of minced meat and vegetables into a plastic bowl. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the textures of the ingredients. Yellow captions appear at the bottom center. (3) A close-up view of a cooked fish fillet covered in a vibrant red sauce containing minced garlic and chili peppers. The fish is presented in a circular bento container with white walls. (4) Detailed view of a 'Thai basil pork' dish within a bento container. The dish features minced meat, green basil leaves, and red chili, accompanied by side dishes like cabbage, a boiled egg, and pumpkin. (5) The chef, still in their apron and mask, holds a white bowl filled with fresh green basil leaves. They proceed to drop a handful of these leaves into the wok which contains a sizzling mixture of meat and peppers. (6) A handheld close-up of a plastic spoon lifting a portion of the stir-fried minced meat, showing the glisten of the sauce and the bits of basil. Then, the meat is spooned onto a bed of white rice in a bowl. (7) Close-up of chopsticks picking up a piece of the fish fillet from earlier, revealing the flaky white meat beneath the spicy red topping. The camera stays focused on the interaction between the chopsticks and the food. (8) A new dish featuring several whole deshelled shrimps stir-fried with translucent onion slices is shown in close-up. A shrimp is lifted by chopsticks to showcase its freshness and curled shape. (9) A close-up shot of a chicken and zucchini stir-fry dish. The chicken pieces are pale and tender-looking, mixed with green-rimmed zucchini slices in a light sauce. (10) The camera pans across the side dishes of the bento box, identifying cabbage, pieces of pumpkin, baby corn, and black fungus, all neatly arranged next to half a boiled egg. (11) A plastic bottle pours a light brown, opaque liquid (Thai milk tea) into a small paper cup. The pouring motion is smooth and centered in the frame. (12) A shot of the shop's menu board displaying prices and dish names like 'PORK' and 'CHICKEN' with small cartoon illustrations. The text is clear and informative. (13) The camera shows a clean, brightly lit indoor dining area with white walls, simple round tables, and white chairs. Finally, an exterior shot of the shop's glass entrance with various promotional stickers and a welcome sign is shown.
